title: progress indicator out of order returnable
name: Progress indicator out of order returnable
rule: Progress indicator is for out-of-order, returnable tasks (tax return / driver’s licence). Named states: `todo` / `doing` / `done`. Dual-cite USWDS linear step indicator and GOV.UK “test without a progress indicator”; do not collapse into one progress widget.
pass_when: Non-linear returnable tasks use the GOLD indicator with todo/doing/done; linear wizards are not forced into this widget (USWDS linear / GOV.UK test-without remain dual-cites).
fail_when: A linear one-way wizard is this GOLD out-of-order indicator, or todo/doing/done is collapsed with USWDS linear / GOV.UK no-indicator into one house widget.
overview: GOLD progress indicator suits out-of-order returnable tasks with todo/doing/done.
apply_when: Non-linear returnable tasks like tax return or driver’s licence flows.
not_when: Forcing linear one-way wizards into this GOLD out-of-order widget.
agent_hint: Use todo/doing/done for returnable non-linear tasks; keep linear cites separate.
